commitResults.messageTitle: Build one JAR with universal Mac natives
commitResults.messageBody:
Merge matching JavaFX Mac libraries with Apple lipo in CI and verify both upstream slices. Preserve Windows and Linux payload checks and share the candidate across the platform matrix.

Keep published release instructions distinct from the unverified candidate. Native GUI smoke tests remain required before release.

commitResults.messageTitle: Keep native checks out of default builds
commitResults.messageBody:
Skip packaged-native verification in ordinary Windows and Linux
check runs unless the prepared universal bundle is supplied.
Keep packaging CI's explicit verification and bundle-backed
platform checks intact, and document the task conditions.

Normalize pasted tab characters to ASCII spaces at the command
text-field boundary before JavaFX can discard them.

Add JavaFX regression coverage for one or multiple tabs, invalid
input, ordinary spaces, and persisted address/tag separation.
Document the paste behavior.

Delegate normalized tab paste to the inherited JavaFX operation so the
paste remains a separate undoable edit.

Add regression coverage that verifies Undo restores the exact
pre-paste text and Redo restores normalized content. Document the
override contract.

Normalize pasted tabs through a paste-scoped TextFormatter instead of
rewriting the system clipboard. This preserves inherited undo records
without relying on platform clipboard propagation.
